_note: Synthetic data, fictional company. Release cards for the fictional Apex platform.

cards.title: Row level policies with parent and child keys
cards.summary: Row level policies can key on a partner ID and include child partners through a mapping table. One level of parent and child is supported out of the box. Deeper hierarchies should be validated on customer data first.
cards.use_when: A customer shares dashboards with partners who should only see their own rows, including sub partners.

cards.title: OIDC custom claim mapping
cards.summary: Map a custom OIDC claim to Apex roles. Supports flat claims only (a string or a list of strings). Nested object claims are in private preview with no announced general availability date. Confirm with the identity team before committing a date.
cards.use_when: A customer runs its own identity provider or sends groups in a non standard claim.

cards.title: Streaming merge for inventory and orders
cards.summary: Merge point of sale and order streams into one model with a 5 minute refresh, without a separate streaming product. Projection to reorder point is computed per store in parallel.
cards.use_when: Retail or distribution customers need near real time on hand that includes open orders. Useful when a batch first vendor is the alternative.

cards.title: Customer managed keys
cards.summary: Customers can hold their own encryption keys in a major cloud key management service. On premises HSMs are not supported. The encryption whitepaper covers the key hierarchy.
cards.use_when: Security or compliance asks who holds the keys.

cards.title: Warehouse connector continuous sync
cards.summary: The warehouse connector now syncs continuously, about 1 minute end to end. Continuous sync is the default for new connections. Existing connections opt in per connection.
cards.use_when: Any freshness question about the warehouse connector.
cards.supersedes: Hourly batch sync for the warehouse connector (behavior before 2026-08-12).

cards.title: Guided onboarding program
cards.summary: A named Apex implementation engineer, a first use case plan with named owners on both sides, and an estimate of customer effort by role (hours per week). Built for lean data teams.
cards.use_when: A customer raises implementation effort, team capacity, or a painful past migration.

cards.title: EU region with EU only support access
cards.summary: Tenants can be pinned to the Frankfurt region, including backups and audit logs. A tenant setting restricts support access to EU based staff. Contract wording should be confirmed with Apex compliance.
cards.use_when: Data residency or support access location comes up.
